summary: Treat a recording device or biological process as a transformation from input over time to output over time.
outcomes: Predict convolution outputs from an impulse response.
Explain when a linear time-invariant approximation is useful and when it fails.
sequence: Follow a brief input through a slow system
Connect transfer functions and frequency response

visual.question: How does a short event become a long measured waveform?
visual.interaction: Slide an impulse-response kernel across a signal and sum its contributions.

practice.task: Compute a short convolution by hand and reproduce it numerically.
practice.success: Aligns time axes correctly and identifies one biological violation of the model.
